0022600216.text: The Trail Blazers (6-3, 8th in the West and 3rd in the Northwest, 1.5 games back) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2, 1st in the West and 1st in the Northwest) as they come off a two-game losing streak, while Oklahoma City has won four straight and is 5-0 at home. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Robert Williams III (rest), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), and Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 Portland lost the series 1-3, including a 124-95 loss in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025.
